title: $24 Million and Counting: LNP Machining Finds Limitless Opportunity with Xometry
summary: Becoming part of the Xometry Partner Network early on helped LNP Machining secure a steady stream of aerospace projects that have brought in more than $24 million.
body_markdown:
Within its first year as a partner, Xometry orders became 100% of LNP's business. The company has completed almost 2,000 Xometry jobs since 2019, and the value of jobs has steadily increased over time.


Xometry uses AI for predictive pricing and strategic matchmaking to connect its partners with the right jobs. Being able to choose from an array of jobs — which includes single projects that bring in more than $1M — has paved the way for impressive growth for LNP. The company’s revenue grew from $800,000 in its first year to more than $10M in 2025, an increase of more than 1,000%. Xometry jobs have generated more than $24.7 million for LNP, enabling the company to invest in technology and personnel. Since partnering with Xometry, LNP has added 5-axis vertical mills and expanded from a staff of just two employees to more than 30.


When it comes to future growth, the sky’s the limit. Pham is excited to see what additional opportunities Xometry and LNP can pursue together.


“We’re more than a shop — we’re a team of passionate engineers and machinists who love bringing ideas to life,” he said. “Xometry gives us the opportunity to do that every day for customers across the country.”
